installation.title: General configuration
installation.description: Configure the shared system. Control starts disabled. Do not share outputs with another controller.

zone.title: Add thermostat
zone.description: Select the devices and initial temperature. The thermostat is created off. Profiles, schedules and optional features are available in its settings and controls. Cooling requires independent condensation protection. This integration and optional water diagnostics do not provide it.

error.schedule_in_use: Switch off Use schedule before removing its last block.
error.invalid_actuators: Choose at least one actuator, without duplicates.
error.actuator_assigned: This actuator is already assigned to another zone or the inlet.
error.entity_missing: A selected entity does not exist.
error.invalid_configuration: Check the values and required fields.
error.schedule_changed: The block changed or does not include those days. Select it again.
error.schedule_conflict: Another block already occupies a destination day/time. The agenda has not changed.

init.title: Climate settings
init.description: Choose a section. Profile temperatures and feature switches are on each thermostat device. Turning a thermostat off keeps it off until explicitly turned on.

hardware.title: Settings
hardware.description: Logical settings apply without retiring relays. Changing sensors, relays or modes may reload the entry and close outputs; review before enabling. Freshness counts from the last report HA records, not the last temperature change; match the limit to the source. Cooling requires independent condensation protection.

schedule_add.title: Weekly schedule
schedule_add.description: Profiles last until the next block, including across midnight. Select all week, weekdays, weekend or individual days. Adding an existing day/time replaces its profile; use Edit to move a block.

schedule_remove.title: Delete a block
schedule_remove.description: Delete the selected days from this block; empty removes all its days. Disable scheduling before removing its last block.

data.scope: Affected days (empty = every day in the block)

hydraulic.title: Optional hydraulic diagnostics
hydraulic.description: Read only; never changes thermostats or learning. References must come from your installation, not universal tables. No flow or valve position feedback: observations are not proof of a community fault. Blank references disable supply threshold warnings. No automatic notifications.

sources.title: Optional sources and optimisation
sources.description: Shared solar source: {solar_source}. Empty sources inherit the installation. Orientation is the fixed window direction; azimuth is the changing sun direction. Angular allowance applies on both sides. Elevation excludes buildings: calibrate shadows per zone. Geometry edits clear confirmation; save, then confirm without changing it. Solar lead differs from schedule advance: heating only, active confirmed solar, favourable forecast and temperature close to comfort. Observation never acts. No forecast means no preventive solar pause.

data.solar_width: Allowed angle on each side of window orientation (°)

vacation.title: Vacation
vacation.description: From General configuration this applies Away to all loaded zones; from a thermostat, only that zone. Off zones remain off. An optional return date ends the absence; blank means indefinite. Activating replaces previous manual holds; later manual changes take priority.

schedule_choose.title: Choose a block to edit
schedule_choose.description: Choose a block and optionally restrict which days to edit. Other days remain unchanged. Next, edit its days, time and profile.

data.scope: Affected days (empty = every day in the block)

schedule_edit.title: Edit days, time and profile
schedule_edit.description: Replace only the days chosen in the previous step, removing their old start time. Existing destination blocks are never overwritten: resolve collisions first.

solar_source.title: Shared solar position
solar_source.description: Defaults to sun.sun. Alternatively select an entity with azimuth/elevation attributes or two sensors in degrees. Elevation 0° is the calculated location horizon, not buildings blocking windows. After changing sources, review and reconfirm zone exposure before optimising. Does not control blinds.

data.sun_entity: Entity with azimuth and elevation attributes

actuator_attention.title: Actuator review needed
actuator_attention.description: Active faults: {faults}. Retired outputs pending: {retired}. Check actuator_incidents on Climate enabled for the cause and automatic close verification. To acknowledge a reviewed fault, turn Climate enabled off, check the close and select the relay in Reset actuator faults after review. For an unassigned, physically disconnected output, use Acknowledge physical removal.

copy_settings.name: Copy thermostat settings
copy_settings.description: Copies selected settings. Blank targets selects the other zones. Does not copy hardware or enable off zones.

reset_actuator_faults.name: Reset actuator faults after review
reset_actuator_faults.description: With Climate enabled off, acknowledge reviewed faults. Selected outputs must report off and not be pending retirement. Does not enable control.

confirmed_review.name: I reviewed the cause and reported states

acknowledge_retired_actuator.name: Confirm physical removal of a retired actuator
acknowledge_retired_actuator.description: Only with Climate enabled off after checking physical disconnection. Releases an unassigned retired output; does not prove valve closure.

confirmed_disconnected.name: I checked it is physically disconnected
